Positive off-diagonal support thresholds follow from minimum arc lengths. Fresh, separately implemented enumeration of all 3^n words for n=1..9 agrees with symbolic GF by each support type, but unrestricted n relies on the exact Eulerian case decomposition.

final_claim: For cyclic words of length n>=1 on three labelled symbols, the bivariate enumerator by length and positive off-diagonal ordered-transition types is 3L+3H/(1-z)^2+(2u^3z^3/(1-z^3)*(1+uz^2/(1-z^2))^3+3H^2+H^3)/(1-z)^3, L=z/(1-z), H=u^2z^2/(1-z^2). Off-diagonal supports are exactly {0,2,3,4,5,6}; first lengths 1,2,3,4,7,6 respectively. Zero-error profile-channel code size equals number of realized profiles.
limitations: Only 3 labelled symbols, cyclic length-two reads, off-diagonal *types*; no noisy-channel capability or counting words per profile.
